svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How Ramen governs MCP tools
svg.desc: A person and their LLM client send an MCP call to Ramen. Ramen checks who they are and their role, runs NeMo guardrails on the tool, only serves tools that passed promptfoo evals and SkillSpector scans at deploy, runs the tool on workers, and writes a log line per call, the console audit and Phoenix traces. It answers the LLM with the result, the tools it may use and the group's rules, and records everything.
svg.text: How Ramen governs your MCP tools
Every call from every client passes the same checks, and leaves a record.
Entra ID, Google or any OIDC · OAuth 2.1 · a role per group
NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails before the call and after the result
Gates before a tool goes live
promptfoo evals + NVIDIA SkillSpector scans check each deploy
Python from your git repo · zones · autoscaled · can sleep when idle
a log line per call · audit of console actions · Phoenix traces
answer + rules back to your client
